label: Left axillary artery
synonyms: Axillary part of trunk of left subclavian artery

tier1.text: The axillary artery sends blood to the brachial artery, its continuation in the upper arm. It also feeds the area near the top of the humerus, the upper arm bone. It begins where the subclavian artery, which supplies the arms and shoulders, enters the armpit.
